Le nin i n the last century, that
capitalism has reached a n ew stage
of develo p ment in the fo rm o f
imperialism, that its e xi sten ce is
based o n expansionism and conflicts
between rival capitalist blocs and tha t
wars are the instr um ental reason of
modern capita lism, rema ins true to
th is day. Not o nly are wars important
for imperialism, they now form th e
